observation_provenance.inputs: Only official observations and reset-local own history. No true state or future44data used for pre43 risk decision.

pre_failure_risk.conclusion: Current raw-row and width-reference disagreement is observable before the failure. The same selected action fails on the current raw alternative. This is not proof that raw is a true lane or that it predicts all future observations.
pre_failure_risk.earlier_limit: At41/42 the raw alternative already demands substantially lower speed, so those states do not establish a feasible late rescue.

minimal_trial.new_reference: Exact existing raw-reference branch from the CURRENT image, own current objects and existing Gaussian/deformation/curvature/stop/launch formulas. Independent COM projection.
minimal_trial.admission: Require existing firstcommand to pass complete original12hold certification on selected and rawfallback references. SameScene/state/history/limits, respective existing feedback continuations; score remains PRIMARYfirstholdprogress thenpedal.
minimal_trial.activation: Every width-reference observation, beginning at its first use; no caseindex or fitted riskthreshold. Raw-reference mode remains unchanged.
minimal_trial.cost_accounting: One shared model counter and geometry/force/tick budget. Total certificates are forecast_calls plus observation_fallback_forecast_calls. Existingcandidatecardinality is unchanged.

ordering_optimization.limit: Conjunction/action equivalence is conditional on not hitting resource caps; resource order was explicitly tested.

actual_reset_results.comparison_limit: More admitted actions did not mean more route progress. Different-length singleDEV runs are not an isolated throughput estimate.

trial_failure_replay.inputs: Full pre-act reset-local memory and pixels; persistent counter restored and replay delta charged separately; no true state read.

guard_failure_attribution.decision: The additional conjunction caused a deadlock at51 and routeprogress was lower than the retained default. Do notpromote.

historical_reference_probe.decision: Rejected: fresh-road/FOV support alone does not justify raising the speed reference from24.46 to37.56m/s to recover admission. No optimistic reference substitution was implemented.

remaining_blocker_and_scope.finding: Both present reference hypotheses are not automatically interchangeable controllable trajectories. Conjoining them can empty the action set, while choosing the older more permissive speed reference lacks validity evidence.
remaining_blocker_and_scope.needed_before_implementation: Define an evidence-based reference availability/adoption/transition rule: what current pixel/own-history evidence makes a reference eligible, when a newreference may replace it, and what supported contingency remains when it becomes unavailable. This requires new reference-validity or observation-transition assumptions beyond this candidate/certifier-only filter; no such rule or broadplanner has been implemented.
remaining_blocker_and_scope.limits: No claim that every possible smallrepair is impossible. No input-error assumption, unseenroad, safety relaxation, model/objective/horizon change, lap-time search, HOLDOUT/SEALED/reserve or new paid environment.
